name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom
summary: A transferable Craftsman's Writ requests an Elixir of Wisdom and gives details for delivery and payment. The writ is needed to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A faded note called Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom asks you to bring one Elixir of Wisdom. It includes a delivery location and payment details, and the writ can pass from hand to hand. You need to hold the writ when you complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: It requests one Elixir of Wisdom.

faq.q: Can I pass the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
aliases: what do I need for delivery
faq.answer: You need the requested item and the writ in your possession. The note gives the delivery location and payment details.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom
